sources.title: NIWA — named varieties and coded selections
sources.enumerated_scope: All 18 linked names in red/yellow/purple/black raspberry, blackberry and strawberry groups.
sources.limitations: Black raspberry remains raspberry. Named code pairs are source assertions, not confirmed aliases or official denominations. Several links point to clone pages; this listing does not establish commercial release, ownership, rights or growing regions.
